body: The silence is oppressive now, like a black cloud settling over my head. I take a deep breath, trying to calm my racing heart. My fingers tremble as they reach for the handle of the heavy oak door that leads outside. I push open the screen door, letting the cold night air rush inside the museum case. Outside, stars twinkle above me, casting a soft glow on the wet asphalt below. I step out onto the sidewalk, feeling a slight breeze brush against my skin. A few tourists stop to watch me cautiously approach their destination, but none seem to be aware of anything unusual.
